shared_elements: human figure(s) shown frontally or in profile
incised linear detail on garment or body
suggestion of arms/hands across the torso
justification: Both depict the human form with headgear and incised surface detail on the body, but A is a narrative relief frieze of a procession of five bearded figures in profile, richly detailed, holding cups and vessels and touching one another, on a base of rosettes, while B is a single massive frontal figure with a blocky schematic head, huge nose and brow, and a few large boss-like and circular incisions on the torso. The specificity of A's repeated profile courtiers with attributes has no counterpart in B's isolated, radically simplified frontal statue, so only the most generic human-figure element is shared.
